result.summary: W1 core PATCH_DRAFT: Starter Realm scene/UI wiring for G3 vertical slice. Controller holds live snapshot id / session context (apply_snapshot_context from fixture or builder call sites only — no bridge ownership). Panel displays quest title, companion text placeholder, status, and preview stage banner. Executor-facing methods: get_session_context(), set_quest_summary(text), set_status(text), show_preview_banner(stage). Mounted from main.gd under UI without changing 2.5D fixed camera. No TTS. No executor transaction logic.

Session context hold + fixture/builder apply call-site API
Quest / status / preview banner surface for executor

set_status.effects: updates panel Status line; emits status_changed

show_preview_banner.effects: shows center banner for wireframe|hologram|materializing|complete; empty/none/idle hides; emits preview_banner_changed
